newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Pacific says Riaupaper on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Asia Pacific says Riaupaper on schedule.

text.p: Asia Pacific Resources International Holdings Ltd (April) said on Friday it will terminate its joint-venture with South Korea's Hansol Paper Co Ltd but the Riaupaper mill project is on schedule.
April and Hansol signed a joint venture agreement last year to build a mill in Riau, Indonesia to produce 600,000 tonnes of uncoated woodfree paper a year.
Under the agreement, April would own 70 percent and Hansol 30 percent in the joint venture.
"Concurrently, the two parties had also intended a cross-investment whereby April would invest a similar amount of money into the shares of Hansol," April said in a statement.
"Owing to other corporate commiments, April and Hansol have decided today that it would be in their mutual interest to terminate the agreement," it said.
April said, however, the decision would not affect the schedule for the Riaupaper mill project, which is expected to begin commercial operations in the second half of 1998.
Both groups will continue to seek opportunities for co-operation and complementary alliances in other areas of businesses, it said.
